The approval was based on an overall response rate of 38 percent (95% CI: 27, 50) among 72 patients with recurrent or metastatic disease who had progressed after platinum-based chemotherapy. The median duration of response was 7.4 months. Accelerated approval was granted under regulations that allow a drug to be approved on the basis of a surrogate endpoint reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit; continued approval may depend on verification in a confirmatory trial. Serious adverse reactions occurred in 41 percent of patients, most commonly pneumonia and dehydration. Dose modification was required in 29 percent. The prescribing information carries a warning for immune-mediated adverse reactions and advises monitoring liver function before and during treatment.
